description: On the table in front of you are yellow curved plastic link pieces with holes, small wooden blocks, two black wheels, and a short bolt with a yellow cap. The left hand picks up a yellow link and holds it steady while the right hand lifts the capped bolt, threads it through a wheel and the link, then brings in a second yellow link so both hands briefly hold the stacked links as the right hand adjusts and tightens the connection; next, the right hand adds a wooden block onto the bolt and twists it to secure, and both hands set the partly assembled piece down with a wheel on one end.
